messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canaries for release v2.0.1 in us-central failing liveness probes; auto-rolled back to v2.0.0. Details: https://deploys.redwood/4156789012 :rotating_light:
Riley T.: Copy. Any idea which change triggered this?
Jordan P.: My hunch is the lazy-kv flush change from yesterday (commit b7f3a). Seen stalls on long chat sessions in staging.
Casey M.: We should do an expedited hotfix. Plan: pin traffic to v2.0.0, push a small patch, run smoke evals, then lift pin. Ops, can we support skip-canary?
oncall-ops: Oncall here. We can support expedited path if we get: explicit rollback triggers, a 45m observation window, and a perf baseline check. No infra prep blockers.
release-coordinator: Change window granted: now -> +90m. Please include release-note stub and owner.
Riley T.: Opening hotfix PR + tests now. Will add smoke prompts.
Jordan P.: PR: https://git.redwood/patches/9001  Draft release note: "hotfix: fix lazy-kv flush causing tokenizer stalls on long sequences". Will refine. :memo:
Casey M.: Suggested deploy command (ops):
```
deploybot expedite --pin v2.0.0 --patch v2.0.1-hotfix-01 --skip-canary --window 45m --owner riley
```
release-coordinator: Reminder: flip off feature flag `kv_lazy_flush` before rollout.
Riley T.: Turning FF off now. Patch builds green.
deploy-bot: Expedite command received from Riley T.. Starting staged rollout (skip-canary). Notifying owners.
deploy-bot: Rollout 30% - healthchecks passing. Telemetry: https://metrics.redwood/r/4156789012
oncall-ops: Watching p50/p95 and errors. Rollback triggers: errors >0.4% for 3m OR p95 increase >200ms for 3m. Also monitor KV miss ratio >2.5% for 10m.
Casey M.: Smoke eval set `chat-longseq-smoke` running at +6m.
Jordan P.: Small p95 blip at +9m but comes back down. No action yet.
Riley T.: Noted. Keeping a close eye on memory and kv stall traces.
deploy-bot: Rollout 70% - still green.
oncall-ops: We see a brief error rate uptick to 0.6% at +13m, persisted for ~2m, then trended down. Not meeting 3m trigger yet.
Casey M.: I'm proposing a quick rollback vote if it crosses 0.5% for another minute.
Jordan P.: I'll tail logs; looks like a downstream worker timeout spike that coincided with a compaction job. Might be noisy.
riley t.: cancelling rollback vote for now — metrics stabilizing at +18m.
release-coordinator: Good catch. Keep pin in place while we monitor. Posting updated release note and pinging support.
Casey M.: Patch confirmed stable at +22m. Will schedule a canary re-check for tomorrow's normal window.
Riley T.: Locking traffic pin to v2.0.0 for 12h and filing follow-up ticket: https://issues.redwood/FT-2042  Owner: Riley T.
Jordan P.: I'll take the RCA and coordinate longer-term fix and perf regression tests.
oncall-ops: Closing monitoring loop; nothing else to escalate.
Casey M.: Thanks team — fast and safe. Moving to observation mode. :thumbsup:
